entities.name: Ekai Kawaguchi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ekai Kawaguchi  was a Japanese Buddhist monk who was famed for his four journeys to Nepal and two to Tibet. He was the first recorded Japanese citizen to travel to either country.
